findings.evidence: The exact guide sentence is `The pastries taste of home to many residents`, using `taste of home` as a verb with a food subject. Current grammar teaches only `a/the taste of home`, and all seven-step target-bearing models and answers use the noun. A regex hit on the source hides the unaddressed grammatical form.
